description: Known vulnerabilities for an open-source package version from OSV.dev (GitHub advisories, PyPI, npm, Go, Maven, crates.io...): id, CVE aliases, summary, severity, fixed versions, references. Plus what plain OSV lacks: CISA KEV 'exploited in the wild' flag + date, FIRST EPSS exploit probability, exploited/most-likely first, and one verified upgrade version that fixes every listed vuln. ~1 s. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.002 per call via x402 at https://2-29-135-242.sslip.io/x402/osv-vulns.
